why: Source: build annual pay from salary and two rate x (count x average) bonuses, compute annual hours, divide, eliminate wrong shapes (about 3 steps); question: the same pay build, hours and division (about 3 steps).

Source: spot the pie's base trap, sum three slices, multiply by the bar share, reject the others (one scaled check, a base-trap check and a no-data check) (about 5 steps); question: the same base trap, three-slice sum x 47%, the same rejections (about 5 steps).
Source: fixed cost in dollars, contribution per revenue dollar, break-even revenue, percentage increase (4 steps); question: the same four steps with a 7c contribution (4 steps).
Source: read five labelled bars, sum two groups, apply -20% and +30%, add (about 5 steps); question: the same readings and groupings, apply -25% and +40%, add (about 5 steps).

Source: two growth rates from the table, two projected revenues, read two 2013 margins off unlabelled gridlines, two profits, ratio (about 7 steps, or fewer via the equal-2013-profit shortcut); question: the same growth rates, projections, gridline margin readings, profits and ratio with the same shortcut (about 7 steps).

Source: read price, cost and volume off unlabelled dual-axis gridlines, side-business profit per customer (10 x 30%), four per-option combined profits, compare (about 6 steps); question: the same gridline readings, bar profit (10 x 35%), four combined profits, compare (about 6 steps).

Source: read two revenue and two market-size values off unlabelled dual-axis gridlines, two shares, difference, divide by three years (about 6 steps); question: the same four readings, two shares, difference, divide by three (about 6 steps).

Source: spot that the second pie is a share of the main-reason group, multiply two shares, reject the no-spending, base-trap and main-versus-only statements (about 4 steps); question: the same base trap and product (70% x 30%), the same three rejections (about 4 steps).

Source: customers per quintile, telescoped step-ups (Q5 - Q1), multiply, ignoring the distracting 90-day table (about 3 steps); question: drivers per quintile, the same telescoped difference and product with the same distractor (about 3 steps).

Source: total cost from fixed plus volume x variable, four cumulative-difference per-head checks, pick the false one (about 6 steps); question: the same total-cost build and four per-home checks (about 6 steps).
